name: Text Placeholder 2
text:
Current Issues:
Preliminary incident report quality and detail can vary greatly
Leading factors and safety trends are sometimes missed 
Objectives:
Deploy a multi-agent AI pipeline that guides workers through incident documentation
Extract structured data automatically, and evaluate historical patterns to support safety personnel
Approach:
Multi-agent LLM pipeline
Qwen as baseline LLM
Vision-Language model for uploaded photo/video
Vector DB for comparing incidents
Potential Impact:
Enhanced Investigations
Standardized Reporting
Identifying common causes & risk factors across incidents

name: Text Placeholder 2
text:
Current Issues:
Incident records can arrive near-empty, sometimes just a single-line narrative
Supporting documents are missing, and root causes go unproven or unchecked
Objectives:
Deploy an 8-phase RCA pipeline that turns an incident record into a defensible root-cause analysis
Tag all verifiable facts and mark missing information 
Approach:
Reads each record "near-empty" and seals investigator conclusions, so the model cannot cheat
Mechanical provenance in code (grounded vs. inferred), 
with absence-as-finding for every missing document
Potential Impact:
Defensible, Auditable Investigations
Standardized 8-Phase Method
Engineering-First Corrective Actions
